blocks.text: Amid pregnancy rumors, Sarah Geronimo alongside her husband, Matteo Guidicelli, attended the final night of Regine Velasquez’s “Finale” concert. While other celebrities watched the concert from the arena’s regular audience seats, Geronimo and Guidicelli opted to watch from a private suite on Level 3 of the venue, away from the main audience, on the third night of Velasquez’s concert series. A video shared by concertgoer Jose Carlo Ventosa on TikTok showed Geronimo and Guidicelli applauding as Ogie Alcasid paid tribute to Velasquez’s during the show.
